Subject: Thanks for downloading the benchmark report

Hi Lina,

Thanks for downloading the Redwood Inference Benchmark report. We compiled a short summary for QuantifyAI and attached the PDF — hope you find the throughput/latency breakdown useful. If you'd like a quick, 25-minute walkthrough we can book a demo with a solutions engineer.

Best,
Redwood Benchmark Team

--- Attachment: QuantifyAI_benchmark_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

On Tue, 14 Sep 2027 at 09:35, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:

To: lina.wu@quantifyai.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:35:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Thanks for downloading the benchmark report

Hi Lina — great to meet you (virtually) and glad the report was helpful. I cover inbound demos for mid-market accounts — happy to walk through the deck and surface how Redwood could fit into your inference stack.

Quick context: our walk-throughs are ~25 minutes, focused on how the benchmark numbers map to real-world latency and cost levers (batching, KV caching, quantization). Ben (cc'd) is our solutions engineer and can join for the short technical bits.

I tried to auto-book a slot using the calendar link on the report page, but it looks like the auto-booker picked a time in UTC and Lina's calendar showed a conflict. Apologies for the friction — can we try manual options?

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Thu 9/16 10:00–10:25
- Thu 9/16 14:00–14:25
- Fri 9/17 08:30–08:55

If none of these work, reply with 2–3 times that do and I'll coordinate on our side. I can also drop a calendar invite once we agree.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference

Tom: thanks for joining — if you can accept the invite once Jasmine sends it that'd be great.

Jasmine — can you send the calendar invite to lina.wu@quantifyai.com and tom.alvarez@quantifyai.com? Please include an attendee dial-in and the short deck. I'll attach a one-page tech note to the invite (no heavy pre-read).
